items.evidence: The log shows 19 µL master mix, 2.5 µL forward and 2.5 µL reverse primer, and 1 µL template going into pcr_plate A1:G1. The template pairing A1, A1, B1, C1, A1, A1, D1 is correct, and the master mix is built from 106, 40, 4 and 2 µL.

The code adds 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI to A1:G1 and mixes 3 times at 30 µL (log lines 198-336). The 37/65°C incubation and the Zymo clean-up are recorded in protocol.comment in the right order.

The assembly wells receive 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3 µL fragment 2, 2 µL fragment 5, 3 µL fragment 6, 2 µL of fragments 1/3/4/7 and 1 µL enzyme mix. Each enzyme addition is followed by a 5-cycle mix (log lines 338-488).

The Golden Gate program (30 cycles of 37/16°C, 60°C, hold 4°C) and the assembly clean-up are recorded as comments. The log then shows 5 µL moved from assembly_plate A1:D1 to cells_plate A1:D1, and 250 µL LB added to each cell well. Heat shock and recovery are recorded as comments.

The xfer helper drops the tip after every destination, so the log shows a fresh pick-up and drop-tip for each transfer. The mixes use a fresh tip per well, and no tip is reused across different fragments or assemblies.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the specified volumes, well pairings and order in the simulator log. Non-pipetting steps are recorded as comments, and a fresh tip is used for every destination.
